biomarkers.name: Ki-67
biomarkers.prevalence: Usually <30%; often overlaps ~5-20%, not a strict definitional criterion
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supportive proliferative marker; distinction from typical relies primarily on mitotic count and necrosis rather than Ki-67 alone

biomarkers.name: SSTR2
biomarkers.prevalence: Positive in a majority/subset; may be lower or more heterogeneous than typical carcinoid
biomarkers.clinical_use: Identifies somatostatin receptor expression and potential PRRT candidate

biomarkers.name: MEN1, ATRX/DAXX mutations
biomarkers.prevalence: MEN1 in a subset; ATRX/DAXX alterations uncommon in pulmonary carcinoid

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Similar to typical carcinoid but with 2-10 mitoses/2 mm² and/or foci of necrosis
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Intermediate-grade; Ki-67 is often higher than in typical carcinoid but is not itself the formal grading criterion

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells (PNEC) with intermediate differentiation state
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm — foregut derivative with neuroendocrine differentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Intermediate-grade neuroendocrine — retains synaptophysin/chromogranin/SSTR2 but with higher proliferative activity, mitoses (2-10/2 mm²), and focal necrosis
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Intermediate position on pulmonary NET differentiation spectrum between typical carcinoid and LCNEC/SCLC
